Two side-by-side plots showing the probability of an unreported second as a function of credit score. The left panel (Low/No-Doc) shows a sharp increase in probability starting around score 580, peaking at approximately 0.45. The right panel (Full-Doc) shows a similar trend but with a lower peak, around 0.41. Both plots include individual data points (triangles and circles) and fitted lines (solid blue and dashed yellow).

The figure consists of two side-by-side scatter plots. The left plot, titled 'Low/No-Doc', shows the probability of an unreported second (y-axis, 0 to 0.10) against the credit score (x-axis, 540 to 780). Detailed description: The figure contains two panels. The left panel is labeled 'Low/No-Doc' and the right panel is labeled 'Full-Doc'. Both panels have 'Prob. A horizontal line is drawn at 0.05 on the y-axis of both plots.
